items.title: Bobby Shew interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 1, 2020
items.q: Did you have, with the big bands you played with which included Woody Herman and Goodman and Toshiko and Louie Bellson

ctx.x: You know you open up the Arban book and you play scales and stuff, all you’re doing is trying to accumulate huge amounts of technical facility in hopes, and when your attention is on you in the practice room, what is your goal? Damn I hope I don’t miss any notes here today. You know?

Did you have, with the big bands you played with which included Woody Herman and Goodman and Toshiko and Louie Bellson, did they have — did any of them have leadership qualities that you either resented or admired?
